text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Sonnet and Haiku were the killers. Haiku pushed hard on Gemma, the officer, who stayed quiet until the town voted her out on day two, and Haiku himself was voted out on day one for the same heavy-handed steering. On night three Luna was killed, and Sonnet tried to use her death to pin Terra by inventing things Luna had supposedly said. Sol, the doctor, checked what Luna had actually said and caught the lie, and the town voted Sonnet out. The town won, with Luna and Terra as the citizens.
